principle: Render the bridge as close to Stephan as possible and move only the information that must cross the network.

homeLink.label: HOME · LOCAL LINK
homeLink.renderPreference: Battle Bridge or Quest local rendering through the same versioned Stephanos contract
homeLink.publicInternetDependency: not required for core local surface

caravanRemote.label: CARAVAN · REMOTE STARLINK
caravanRemote.preferredTransport: authenticated Stephanos control plane over Starlink
caravanRemote.renderPreference: spatial shell and comfort-critical rendering local on Quest 3

remoteDegraded.label: REMOTE DEGRADED · READ ONLY
remoteDegraded.trigger: identity, freshness, route, telemetry, or Battle Bridge certainty is insufficient

control.preferredSecurity: authenticated encrypted Stephanos or Tailscale-class route
control.relayPolicy: relay may support observation and proposals but can restrict approvals or execution

media.failurePolicy: must not remove or corrupt the control plane

remoteObservations: Starlink obstruction or service degradation where available
GPU encoder health when media is requested
failClosedRules: do not accept approval from stale state
bind approval to exact target revision
do not reuse approval after proposal or target changes
fall back to read-only when certainty is insufficient
do not execute hidden work after headset or session loss
a disconnected intent may return only as an unapproved draft
remotePcvrStopConditions: packet loss or jitter outside the tested comfort envelope
home upload or caravan download is unstable
display or runtime is not known-good
reconnects or input delay create discomfort risk
acceptanceTests: home and caravan show the same canonical mission
Quest disconnect loses no state or evidence
Starlink interruption causes the expected degraded posture
stale state cannot authorize remote action
control remains useful without media streaming
relayed transport is detected and surfaced
Battle Bridge blockers do not require a local click
media failure cannot affect authority state
phone or tablet can recover the same mission
implementationGate: Prioritise a locally rendered Quest command surface for caravan use. Treat remote PCVR streaming as optional and do not begin execution-capable spatial integration until the parent doctrine readiness gates are proven.
